_note: NPC racers (Phase 4 Step 4: ai/, race/, docs/NPC_RACERS.md). Placeholder values: balancing is Phase 4 Step 5.

skill._note: A driver's skill (0–1) and its seven settings, each from its value at skill 0 to its value at skill 1 (a driver can set any of them on its own). lineAccuracy: how far off the racing line it wanders (m); brakingPoint: the share of the car's braking it plans with (lower: brakes earlier); cornerMargin: the share of the car's grip it corners at; reactionTime: s before it reacts to other cars and to its own errors; consistency: how much its pace varies lap to lap (share); mistakeRate: mistakes a minute; throttle: the most throttle it uses (less skilled drivers don't commit to full power).

mistakes._note: What a mistake is, and how often each kind (weights). runWide: corners on that much more grip than it has (it runs wide); lateBrake: brakes that many metres late; lockUp: stamps on the brake for a moment with ABS off; spin: too much throttle out of a corner with traction control off (rare).

personality._note: aggression (0–1): how often it goes for a gap and how close it'll go; it defends with one move, never into a car alongside. caution (0–1): how much gap it keeps in traffic (seconds of following distance from followGap[0] to [1]). onHit: calm (carries on), angry (more aggressive for a while), rattled (more careful, a little slower for a while).

cars._note: NPC cars are built from the parts system (ai/npcCars.js): a model the quest lets in, upgraded part by part towards the performance target — the rating the quest's class allows × target (1: as fast as the class allows; under 1: a little slower), never past the quest's limits.

damage._note: NPCs take damage by the player's rules (garage/carDamage.js, data/damage.json). Badly damaged (condition under slowFrom %), they go slower in step with it; undrivable, or under retireBelow %, they retire (DNF).

recovery._note: Stuck: hardly moving for stuckSeconds while it should be going → reverse out for reverseSeconds (and again, up to tries). Turned round (spun): straighten up. Still stuck, or further than farFromRoute m off the route: the route's reset (fade out, put back on the route at the last reset point, never into another car: clearance m).

rubberBand._note: Small changes to how an NPC drives by its gap to the player (never its car or the physics): ahead of the player by more than deadZone s, a little more careful (cornerMargin and brakingPoint down by up to strength × gap / range, at most cap); behind, a little bolder (up, at most cap, never past the skill's own top). Off for pink slips and time-based leaderboards, and when the player turns it off.

lod._note: AI level of detail: NPCs within fullWithin m of the player, or in view within visibleWithin m, drive in the full physics; further and out of view for coolDown s, they run along their racing line on their speed plan (no physics) and come back to full physics before switchBack m away — matching place, speed and damage.

race._note: maxNpcs: the most rivals a quest can have; namesOverCars: the drivers' names over their cars (the player can turn them off). What each place pays: data/quests.json race.

spread._note: The tests' target: lap time of a low-skill driver against a high-skill one in the same car (a share slower) — min and max.

defaults._note: A quest's npc settings when it has none (content/quests.js params): count, skill range, drivers ('random' or ids), carClass (null: the quest's own), aggression (null: each driver's own), rubberBand.
